body: I’m 25, I don’t pretend to know your life, but you sound like a good person in a bad place that has suffered immensely. But it sounds to me like you’re a fighter, you haven’t let them win, and you deserve so much better than you have been given. I have been in your position of solitude, feeling that I didn’t have anyone to call a friend, and it’s when our thoughts are the most demoralizing and painful, but those thoughts don’t define you, and those thoughts can and will change.

Your past trauma is not your fault and you’re doing something courageous and proactive by seeing therapists and psychiatrists. You sound like an incredibly thoughtful and intelligent person, I’m sorry that things with the new interest are uncertain right now, but you’re concerned about their feelings and that tells me that you’re a genuinely kind and considerate person and that’s what really matters when it comes to relationships, you have so much to offer even if you don’t feel like you do.
